claims.claim: Two of the four Canadian Armed Forces members killed in the CFB Wainwright fire were from B.C.
claims.episode_span: two of the four Canadian Armed Forces members killed in a fire at CFB Wainwright were from B.C.
claims.source_title: Two soldiers from B.C. among four dead in CFB Wainwright fire
claims.supporting_quote: Two soldiers from B.C. among four dead in CFB Wainwright fire

claims.claim: Rutland identified the dead as Pte. Aidan Goulding, Pte. Shaun Farrell and Pte. Hayden Lykkemark of 3rd Battalion PPCLI at CFB Edmonton, and Sgt. Morgan Wong of the Loyal Edmonton Regiment from Edmonton.
claims.episode_span: The PPCLI soldiers killed are Pte. Aidan Goulding, Pte. Shaun Farrell and Pte. Hayden Lykkemark. The Loyal Edmonton member is Sgt. Morgan Wong, from Edmonton.
claims.source_title: Two soldiers from B.C. among four dead in CFB Wainwright fire
claims.supporting_quote: The PPCLI soldiers killed are Pte. Aidan Goulding, Pte. Shaun Farrell and Pte. Hayden Lykkemark, while the Loyal Edmonton member has been identified as Sgt. Morgan Wong from Edmonton.

claims.claim: The four were killed on a section attack range when a fire swept in, and the ground commander said the fire appeared within 30 seconds to a minute.
claims.episode_span: within 30 seconds to a minute they saw no fire, and then there was a fire right on top of them
claims.source_title: Two soldiers from B.C. among four dead in CFB Wainwright fire
claims.supporting_quote: he said within 30 seconds to a minute they saw no fire, and then there was a fire right on top of them

claims.claim: Premier Danielle Smith said 39 soldiers were injured, including 19 critically, and Acute Care Alberta said 30 units took patients to Edmonton, Red Deer and Calgary.
claims.source_title: Two soldiers from B.C. among four dead in CFB Wainwright fire
claims.supporting_quote: In addition to the deaths, 39 soldiers were injured, including 19 critically, Premier Danielle Smith said Sunday afternoon.

claims.claim: Patricia Farrell posted that Shaun had died and had only recently joined; Kim Goulding wrote that Aidan graduated in August.
claims.episode_span: Kim Goulding posted that Aidan was bright, kind and proud to serve, that he had just graduated in August
claims.source_title: Two soldiers from B.C. among four dead in CFB Wainwright fire
claims.supporting_quote: You had just graduated in August and had your whole life ahead of you — way too young.

claims.claim: Wong had been with the Forces since 2017 and worked in the Treasury Board Secretariat and Hospital and Surgical Health Services; the Loyal Edmonton Regiment is a reserve regiment.
claims.episode_span: had worked in the Treasury Board Secretariat and in Hospital and Surgical Health Services
claims.source_title: Two soldiers from B.C. among four dead in CFB Wainwright fire
claims.supporting_quote: In his day job, Wong had worked over the past three years in a pair of provincial government departments: Treasury Board Secretariat and Hospital and Surgical Health Services.

claims.claim: Four people were sent to hospital after a Coquihalla crash near Merritt, and a 30-kilometre stretch closed between Merritt and Exit 315 around 9 a.m. Saturday near Helmer Road.

claims.source_title: 4 people sent to hospital after Coquihalla crash near Merritt, B.C.
claims.supporting_quote: A 30-kilometre stretch of the highway was closed between Merritt and Exit 315 around 9 a.m. Saturday due to a motor vehicle incident near Helmer Road.

claims.claim: Denise O'Connor and Jennifer Thoss each received 45 votes in preliminary Lytton mayoral results.
claims.episode_span: each received 45 votes in preliminary results released by the Village of Lytton

claims.supporting_quote: Incumbent Denise O'Connor and her challenger, former city councillor Jennifer Thoss, both received 45 votes, according to the preliminary results released by the Village of Lytton.

claims.claim: A B.C. Supreme Court judge found a section of the Controlled Drug and Substances Act unconstitutional, gave Ottawa six months to fix it, and the ruling followed trafficking convictions of Eris Nyx and Jeremy Kalicum after a raid on DULF.
